name: awdk
description: Build AI agent fleets. 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud. Effort-based model routing, 48 identities, knowledge graph memory, fleet orchestration.

paragraphs: The Aither World is an operating system for agents — a Linux you can hand to one, the runtimes it works in, and the tools it works with. awnix is the Linux underneath it; awdk is one of its 67 bricks — each installs on its own, runs offline, and needs no account. Start here: Point it at a backend you already pay for and run one agent loop.
3 lines of code. Any backend. Local or cloud. Zero lock-in.

Aither ADK is a Python SDK + CLI for building AI agents that run on your hardware — a single helpful agent or a coordinated fleet that delegates work to each other. Agents get tools, persistent knowledge-graph memory, safety filtering, and effort-based model routing out of the box. Swap the LLM backend at runtime — your GPU, Ollama, llama.cpp, or any cloud API — same code, same agents.
